topic: That grease smear inside your wheel isn't dirt — it's a torn CV boot
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.narration: See grease flung inside your wheel? That's not dirt.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: inside a vehicle wheel well with the wheel removed, fine dark-grease flecks visible flung across the inner wheel barrel and nearby suspension components, static camera, dim garage lighting.

beats.narration: A torn CV boot slings grease everywhere it can reach — and doesn't make a sound yet.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a torn accordion-fold rubber CV boot, a visible split along one fold with dark grease coating the surrounding area, static mounted camera, slow push-in.

beats.narration: One clue: no clicking yet doesn't mean it's fine — the joint fails once the grease is gone and dirt gets in.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a clean, intact CV boot on a comparable axle for contrast — taped/clamped seams visible, no tears, no grease residue nearby, static camera, dim garage lighting.

beats.narration: By the time you hear a click on turns, the joint itself may already be damaged — the boot was the warning.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on an exposed CV joint with grease visibly missing/dry and fine grit caught in the joint grooves, static mounted camera.

beats.narration: Worth checking during a routine rotation, before it turns into a full axle replacement.
beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot: a vehicle raised on a shop lift with one wheel removed, a service cart with hand tools resting nearby, no hands or human figures in frame, static camera, workshop lighting.

beats.narration: Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold. Logo and CTA text composited in post, never AI-generated.

postingSpecs.feedCaption: That grease inside your wheel isn't dirt — it's a torn CV boot flinging grease before the joint ever makes a sound. Worth checking during a routine rotation. Stop by and we'll take a look.
